## Problem

What this pull request fixes or adds.

## Approach

How it works and any design decisions worth knowing.

## Automated validation

Exact commands run and their result.

- [ ] `make -C firmware` builds without warnings
- [ ] `make -C firmware test` passes (say whether the differential tests ran)
- [ ] CI passes on the latest commit
- [ ] Code review of the diff done and findings resolved

## Hardware testing

Which unit and firmware were used, and what was checked (gears, buttons,
switch, LEDs, handbrake, flashing, recovery). Write "not needed" for changes
that cannot affect the device, or "pending" if it still has to be done.

- [ ] Tested on a real shifter, or not needed

## Limitations and follow-up

Skipped checks, known issues and follow-up work, or "None".
